vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the ICubemapSides interface, which serves as a strict data contract for managing cubemap texture paths. It mandates six string properties corresponding to the directional faces: right, left, up, bottom, front, and back. Its primary role is to standardize asset referencing across rendering and loading systems within the application. It contains no executable logic or side effects.
